stage: MA24 G02/G05 registered-original download byte integrity and final access check
verifiedBehavior: Full 200 and partial 206 responses contain exact registered bytes.
The lookup requires both registered asset and active document under account access constraints.
Same-size replacement and file growth between stat and read return 410 without file content.
Loss of access during file reading returns 404 without file content.
Changed storage key, hash, byte size or MIME at the final lookup returns 410.
Invalid ranges return 416 only after byte integrity and final access checks.
Malformed UUIDs and anonymous requests are rejected before file access.
scope: Direct GET handler/native Request-Response tests with real SHA-256 and byte-range operations; session, filesystem and tenant-query boundaries are mocked.
limitations: No live HTTP server, real document quality review or production deployment was exercised.
Final access lookup is a point-in-time check, not a grant that survives later revocation.
Does not establish whole-source byte locking for G09 activation.
